<onlyinclude><includeonly><infobox type="holidays">
	<title source="title"><default>{{#explode:{{PAGENAME}}|(}}</default></title>
	<image source="image"><caption source="caption"/></image>
	<data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>
	<data source="date"><label>Observed on</label></data>
	<data source="location"><label>Location</label></data>
	<data source="aka"><label>Other names</label></data>
	<group layout="horizontal">
	    <header>Holiday guide</header>
	    <data source="previous"><label><big>←</big> Previous</label></data>
	    <data source="next"><label>Next <big>→</big></label></data>
	</group>
</infobox>{{#ifeq: {{NAMESPACENUMBER}} | 0 | [[Category:Holidays]]}}</includeonly></onlyinclude>
